brief: A desktop app for working on a repository through agents: prompt, watch, review the diff, comment on lines, send the comments back, commit. For developers who want to review rather than edit. Calm, precise, technical, review-focused.
criteria: Success: unmistakable at 16 px, works in one colour, avoids robot/sparkle/bracket clichés, and says 'show me what changed'.

concepts.name: Delta Square
concepts.idea: A square and its shifted copy: only the change is inked, in ink for what was and green for what is.
rationale: It is the product in one shape: show me what changed
Two Ls with rounded, never-touching corners hold up from 16 px to a building
Ink and diff-green carry meaning: what was, what is now
The wordmark's shared t-crossbar is the same green, tying name and symbol together

recommendation: Use the two-colour Delta Square everywhere it fits, the one-colour versions where it cannot.
next_steps: Drop the icons into the app
Proof the colours in print before use
